name: TwoBarReversalAtNewExtreme
longCondition: el_le(low[1], priorLow) && el_gt(close[0], open[0]) && el_gt(close[0], close[1]) && el_le(low[0], low[1] + overlapTicks * tickSize)
shortCondition: el_ge(high[1], priorHigh) && el_lt(close[0], open[0]) && el_lt(close[0], close[1]) && el_ge(high[0], high[1] - overlapTicks * tickSize)
